query:
UPDATE users 
SET username = CASE 
  WHEN email IS NOT NULL AND email != '' THEN LOWER(REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(email, '@', 1), '.', '_'))
  WHEN name IS NOT NULL AND name != '' THEN LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(name, ' ', '_'), '-', '_'))
  ELSE CONCAT('user_', id)
END
WHERE username IS NULL OR username = '';
